description: Your own product's latest drive in full: every attempt with its time on the drive's clock, route, result and evidence, the fixes, and the record's parts (bot checks, ways in, pay, plan, terms, errors, times). For the product's verified owner only (a verified claim on its domain, then your API key): with an Audit of that drive, the full detail; without one, the counts and how to order it. Anyone else gets 403 owner_only and the public listing (get_tool).
